flows.title: Create a campaign
steps: Go to the Campaigns dashboard and click "+ Add New" in the top right corner to start a new campaign.
Name the campaign, then click "Continue" to proceed. Instantly suggests including the target audience's title, industry, and location in the name so campaigns are easier to find and optimize later.
Go to the campaign's Leads section, click "Add Leads", and choose an upload method such as CSV, SuperSearch, entering emails manually, Google Sheet, HubSpot, or Pipedrive.
Write the email sequence: compose the subject line and email copy for the first email, then add follow-up steps as needed (Instantly recommends 3-4 steps for most cold outreach campaigns).
In the Schedule tab, set the days of the week and the sending times, then click "Launch" once the leads, sequence, and sending accounts are ready.

flows.title: Import leads via CSV
steps: In your campaign's Leads section, click "Add Leads", select CSV, and choose the CSV file to upload from your device.

Map each column with the dropdown menu: map the email column to the predefined "Email" variable (required), map other columns to standard fields like First Name or Company Name, mark personalized columns as a Custom variable, or mark unwanted columns "Do Not Import".
Choose whether to check for duplicate leads across other campaigns and lists, and whether to verify the leads before uploading.
Click "Upload all" to import the leads. Instantly will notify you of any missing or invalid emails, and of any duplicate leads that were skipped.

flows.title: View campaign analytics
steps: Open the campaign and go to its Analytics tab to see key metrics, including Sequence started, Open Rate, Click Rate, and Reply Rate.
Select a longer timeframe, such as Last 3 months, to view complete campaign analytics.
Scroll down to the Step Analytics section to measure the performance of each step and variant in the campaign.
Click "Share" to download the analytics chart for the campaign, which includes Contacted, Opened, Replies, and Opportunities.
